note: paper-to-product layer: investor underwriting and corporate contract decision views

perspective: reform-priced transition-cost risk; fixed-exposure scalar sensitivity

definitions.model_implied_spread: conditional risk charge, not an observed bond or loan spread

definitions.contract_ranking: benefit-only ranking until observed contract premiums/support costs are supplied
definitions.gap_linked_charge: scenario-valued physical-gap loss on a separate basis; never added to the transition-cost charge without a joint covariance model
